The bowstring has been specially engineered for aerial combat, which allows it to be drawn faster than a normal bow.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 9 |durability = 30 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Swallow Bow}} Swallow Bows are [[Bow]]s favored among [[Rito]] warriors. They belong to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype, which consists of [[Weapon]]s that are made and used by the Rito.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} Engineered for aerial combat, the bowstring is able to be drawn faster than those of normal Bows. They can be found most commonly in [[Rito Village]], but some are scattered around the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and [[Hebra Mountains]], either in [[Treasure Chest]]s or being used by [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Scanning the {{BotW}} Series [[Revali]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] has a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Swallow Bow. If the [[Great Eagle Bow]] is ever broken, [[Harth]] can remake it with five bundles of [[Wood]], one [[Diamond]], and a Swallow Bow.{{Cite|I cannot help but notice that your {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Eagle Bow}} is missing.|Harth|BotW}}{{Cite|If you want me to make another one, I will need a {{Color BotW|Blue|swallow bow}}, a {{Color BotW|Blue|diamond}}, and {{Color BotW|Red|five}} bundles of {{Color BotW|Blue|wood}}.|Harth|BotW}} A Swallow Bow can be found on the table next to Harth. If [[Link]] tries to take it, Harth will start to scold him.{{Cite|Hey...|Harth|BotW}} When Link apologizes, Harth decides to let him keep it.{{Cite|[I'm sorry!] Heh... Take it.
Not like I can use it in my condition.|Harth|BotW}}{{Cite|[I'm sorry!] Sure, go ahead and take it. Consider it a thanks for conquering Medoh.|Harth|BotW}} Swallow Bows are made of wood, and they will therefore burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s.
